title: Min Stack
statement: A stack that also reports its minimum. Push, Pop, Top and GetMin must all be O(1). Pop and Top are only called on a non-empty stack.
hints: Scanning for the minimum on demand is O(n), so the minimum has to be maintained as you go.
A single minimum variable fails: popping the minimum leaves you with no idea what the new one is.
Keep a second stack holding the minimum as of each push. Push min(value, current minimum) alongside every value and pop both together.
